pv20:1.1: Naggo kiso pabbajito 'si bhante rattiṃ kuhiṃ gacchasi kissa hetu ācikkha me taṃ api sakkuṇemu sabbena vittaṃ paṭipādaye tuvan ti. || ||
pv20:2.1: Bārāṇasī nagaraṃ dūraghuṭṭhaṃ tatthāhaṃ gahapati aḍḍhako dīno adātā gedhitamano āmisasmiṃ dussīlyena Yamavisayamhi patto. || ||
pv20:3.1: So sūcikāya kilamito tehi ten' eva ñātisu yāmi āmisakiñcihetu adānasīlā na ca saddahanti: dānaphalaṃ hoti paramhi loke. || ||
pv20:4.1: Dhītā ca mayhaṃ lapate abhikkhaṇaṃ; dassāmi dānaṃ pitunnaṃ pitāmahānaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ parivisayanti brāhmaṇe yāmy' ahaṃ Andhakavindaṃ bhottuṃ. || || Tam
pv20:5.1: avoca rājā: anubhaviyāna tam pi eyyāsi khippaṃ aham pi karissaṃ pūjaṃ ācikkha me taṃ yadi atthi hetu saddhāyitaṃ hetuvaco suṇomi. || ||
pv20:6.1: Tathā ti vatvā agamāsi tattha bhuñjiṃsu bhattaṃ na ca pana dakkhiṇārahā paccāgami Rājagahaṃ punāparaṃ pātur ahosi purato janādhipassa. || ||
pv20:7.1: Disvāna petaṃ. punar eva āgataṃ rājā avoca: aham api kiṃ dadāmi ācikkha me taṃ yadi atthi hetu yena tuvaṃ cirataraṃ pīṇito siyā. || || Buddhañ
pv20:8.1: ca saṅghaṃ parivisiyāna rāja annena pānena pi cīvarena taṃ dakkhiṇaṃ ādisā me hitāya evaṃ ahaṃ cirataraṃ pīṇito siyā. || || Tato
pv20:9.1: ca rājā nipatitva tāvade dānaṃ sahatthā atulaṃ daditvā saṅghe ārocayī pakatiṃ tathāgatassa tassa ca petassa dakkhiṇaṃ ādisittha. || ||
pv20:10.1: So pūjito ativiya sobhamāno pātur ahosi purato janādhipassa: yakkho 'ham asmi paramiddhipatto na mayham iddhi samasadisā mānusā. || ||
pv20:11.1: Passānubhāvaṃ aparimitaṃ mamedaṃ tayānuddiṭṭhaṃ atulaṃ daditvā saṅghe santappito satataṃ sadā bahūhi yāmi ahaṃ sukhito manussadevā ti. || ||
